list: (Woman transforms into an old woman named Georgea.)
(A 7-sided stone pedestal sits in front of Player and Georgea. It is bathed in a beam of starlight. Player uses spiral fossil on the pedestal and places it in the center.)
(Player uses the stones on the pedestal to fill the 7 depressions.)

(Player receives handscope. Player uses handscope on the beam of starlight. The screen is filled with a view of a starry sky. Seven distinct bright stars form a ring which corresponds to the seven stones placed upon the pedestal. After watching the stars pulse in a random order, players must duplicate the sequence upon the pedestal by touching the stones in the same order.)
